title: Home charging and exclude-home settings
summary: This topic combines comments about the convenience of home charging with references to the vehicle's exclude-home comfort access setting and home screen guidance.

positive.summary: Positive reviews describe home charging as making charging easier and daily EV use more convenient, with one request framed around wanting an exclude-home button option.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention home chargers, range and charging-time context, exclude-home settings, and home screen instructions without a clear evaluative sentiment in many examples.

limitations: The topic cluster mixes several related but distinct subjects, including home charging, exclude-home comfort access settings, and home screen navigation.
Most sampled fragments are undetermined, which limits confidence in summarizing clear customer sentiment beyond the few explicitly positive examples.
Some undetermined fragments contain favorable or unfavorable wording, but their assigned sentiment should not be reclassified here.
